description: Unique identifier assigned to each image in the combined corn+rice dataset during preprocessing.
Original image filename as provided by the source dataset.
Crop the image belongs to. One of: Corn, Rice.

Target class label used for model training. One of 10 classes: 4 corn (Cercospora_Gray_Leaf_Spot, Common_Rust, Northern_Leaf_Blight, Healthy) and 6 rice (Bacterial_Leaf_Blight, Brown_Spot, Leaf_Blast, Leaf_Scald, Sheath_Blight, Healthy).
Originating dataset the image was sourced from. One of: PlantVillage (raw, GitHub: spMohanty/PlantVillage-Dataset) for corn, Kaggle-AgML-RiceDisease for rice.
Dataset partition the image was assigned to after stratified splitting. One of: train, val, test (70/15/15 split, performed before augmentation).

Near-duplicate group identifier used during deduplication/split-leakage checks (Module 3). Images sharing a group_id originate from the same source leaf/photo sequence and were kept within a single split to prevent leakage.
